cueBody: Prepare songs in the worship editor and capture them into the queue.
verseText:
And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest
to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
giveScripture: "Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver." - 2 Corinthians 9:7
